title: Home
headline: From broadcast pixels to possession value, measured against ground truth at every step
dek: An analytics product built on player tracking. A broadcast video pipeline stands in for the tracking data a team buys, and it is scored against sensor data.
note: The model results on this site come from sensor tracking data. The broadcast demo is an illustration.

review.title: Possession review
review.body: Pick a possession. See its shot quality, its value over time, and where an average defense would have stood.

prep.title: Game and season prep
prep.body: Player views from the season models. Each value shows its interval or says it is a point estimate, and names its minimum sample.

results.title: Results
results.body: The tracking scorecard and every model result. Models that found no signal stay on the list.
